facts.fact: AfDB communique says 935 km of terrestrial and under-river fibre were installed and made operational, as the first sections of the national backbone, along the Bangui-Douala road corridor (Bossembele, Yaloke, Baoro) to Berberati, with branches to Cameroon (Gamboula) and Congo (Bomassa); inaugurated 6 Feb 2023.

facts.fact: AfDB says that at project close in September 2023 the first national optical backbone was installed: 900 km of fibre with eleven technical sites, a network operations centre in Bangui and two community digital centres, linking CAR to Cameroon and Congo.

facts.fact: Ecofin Agency reports that CAR's national fibre backbone was commissioned in 2023 under the Central African Backbone project, with about 935 km deployed, including the Bangui-Boali and Carnot-Berberati routes, and serves as a national backbone.
